gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype, WHO Grade 4 consistent with WHO CNS 2021 criteria. This will include patients with a diagnosis of molecular glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Participants will be enrolled in either Phase 1 or Phase 2 depending on when they join the study. (interventions: Drug: Ivonescimab)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Phase I/II Study of IVONESCIMAB in Recurrent Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: The goal of Phase 2 of this clinical research study is to learn if the recommended Phase 2 dose of ivonescimab found in Phase 1 can help to control the disease.

source_quote.quote: Diagnosis of Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype, WHO Grade 4 consistent with WHO CNS 2021 criteria.

coder_notes: Single-arm phase I/II of ivonescimab monotherapy in recurrent IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. IDH-wildtype is diagnostic only (never candidate-matched). Prior anti-VEGF or anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy is an exclusion (treatment history, not a biomarker). No PK or pharmacodynamic sampling described.
